dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (cobc) project by Sauro Menna, 2016; compiler options visible in comments: cobc -x -fbinary-size=1--8 -fnotrunc -fbinary-byteorder=big-endian

purpose.domain_detail: Sort demonstration/tutorial module showing COBOL SORT verb with input/output procedures, filtering, and totalizer copybooks
purpose.summary: A COBOL sort program (sincsqf04) that reads an input file, filters records by multiple field conditions, sorts them on an ascending key (srt-ch-field), and writes the results to an output file. It uses SORT with INPUT PROCEDURE and OUTPUT PROCEDURE, includes totalizer and environment copybooks, and displays record counts. Appears to be a teaching/example module in a larger sort-tutorial suite.

notable_features: SORT verb with INPUT PROCEDURE and OUTPUT PROCEDURE
Heavy use of COPY statements (12 copybooks) for file-control, FD, working-storage, and procedure sections
Inline comments with ## markers indicating modifiable template placeholders
RELEASE and RETURN verbs for sort file handling
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Compiler directive comments showing GnuCOBOL build options
verdict.notes: The ## markers in comments appear to be template/tutorial annotations indicating where users should modify keys or filtering logic. The program is part of a larger suite (sincsqf01..04 naming pattern). High comment ratio (36%) consistent with tutorial/example code. All four COBOL divisions present; fixed format confirmed.
